name: car-out-game
description: 3D Car Out Traffic Parking Jam Game in React and Node.js

scripts.test:levels: cd server && node -e 'const { solveCarOut } = require("./src/utils/solver"); const levels = require("./src/data/levels.json"); levels.forEach(l => { const r = solveCarOut(l); if (!r.solvable) throw new Error("Level failed"); console.log("Level " + l.id + ": OK"); }); console.log("All levels verified!");'
